# 0301. Xcode project generated by XcodeGen

- Status: accepted, 2026-11-13
- Requirements: PLT-R101, PLT-R102, PLT-R104, PLT-R751, PLT-R910, QA-R24
- Context: The app, the test host and the IMKit spike need an Xcode project (app bundles, Info.plist,
  asset catalogs, String Catalogs, signing). A committed `.xcodeproj` is a merge-conflict magnet when several
  branches are worked on in parallel, and it hides build settings in an opaque file. The product name is temporary, so
  target names must not carry it.

## Decision

1. `project.yml` (XcodeGen) is the only committed description of the Xcode project. `xcodegen generate`
   writes `App.xcodeproj`, which `.gitignore` excludes.
2. Targets and schemes are brand-neutral: `App`, `TestHost`, `SpikeIMK`. The product name, bundle IDs and
   site host come from `Config/Brand.xcconfig` via `Config/Debug.xcconfig` and `Config/Release.xcconfig`
   (`PRODUCT_NAME = $(APP_DISPLAY_NAME)`, `PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER = $(APP_BUNDLE_ID)`).
   `PRODUCT_MODULE_NAME = App` keeps the Swift module name stable across renames.
3. Info.plist files are hand-written (`App/Info.plist`, `TestHost/Info.plist`, `SpikeIMK/Info.plist`) and use
   build-setting substitution (`$(APP_SLUG)`, `$(SPARKLE_FEED_URL)`, ...). Custom keys `AppSlug`,
   `AppSiteHost`, `AppSupportEmail` feed the `Brand` helper (ShellCore).
4. Debug uses `APP_BUNDLE_ID_DEV` and "Apple Development"; Release uses `APP_BUNDLE_ID_RELEASE`,
   "Developer ID Application", `--timestamp`, hardened runtime, universal `ARCHS_STANDARD`, no entitlements
   (PLT-R750, PLT-R751, PLT-R908). Team and identities stay in `Config/Signing.xcconfig`.
5. `Package.resolved` cannot live inside an ignored project, so the resolved Sparkle revision is committed at
   `Config/Package.resolved` and copied into the generated workspace by XcodeGen's `postGenCommand`. CI builds
   with `-disableAutomaticPackageResolution`, so a drift fails the build (PLT-R104, PLT-R910).
6. `compat/rules.json` and `compat/matrix.json` are copied into the app as `compat-rules.json` and
   `compat-matrix.json` by a build phase. A missing file is an error in Release and a warning in Debug (the
   app then uses the embedded ruleset, PLT-R503).
7. `project.yml` and `Packages/AppCore/Package.swift` are frozen for wave-1 workstreams. Changes go through
   the integrator.

## Consequences

- Contributors and CI run `xcodegen generate` before `xcodebuild` (CLAUDE.md "Commands").
- XcodeGen becomes a build-time tool dependency (Homebrew; CI pins its version and SHA-256 per PLT-R910).
- Verified on 2026-11-13 with Xcode 27.2 / Swift 6.4.2: `App`, `TestHost` and `SpikeIMK` build in Debug
  without signing; the Release configuration compiles a universal binary and fails only on the missing
  `compat/rules.json`, as intended until workstream W1-C adds it.

## Alternatives considered

- Committed `.xcodeproj`: rejected (conflicts, opaque diffs).
- Tuist: more powerful but heavier and Swift-manifest based; XcodeGen's YAML is enough for three targets.
- Pure SwiftPM executable for the app: cannot produce a proper app bundle with asset catalogs, String Catalog
  compilation and Sparkle's framework embedding without custom scripts.
